title: Apposta Negroni Riff
byline: Charles Joly for the Negroni Social
ldInstructionsRaw: Combine all ingredients except the soda in a chilled mixing glass. Stir for 12 seconds. Strain into a chilled Collins glass filled with 4 ice cubes. Garnish with orange peel expressed and placed in drink. Add thyme and 2 narrow straws.
